title: Quantum Computing
definition: A rapidly-emerging technology that harnesses the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems too complex for classical computers by using qubits that can exist in superposition states.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology syllabus under GS Paper III (Awareness in the fields of IT, Space, Computers, Robotics, Nanotechnology, Bio-technology and issues relating to intellectual property rights). High relevance for strategic autonomy, cybersecurity (cryptography), drug discovery, and India's National Quantum Mission (NQM).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Quantum Computing.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of classical computing bits
Fundamental physics concepts like atomic states and wave-particle duality
